title: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
SINDH EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Sindh
Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1992]
No. PAS.Legis.B-14/91, dated
22-2-1992.--The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Bill,
1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st day of December,
1990.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Amendment in Sindh Act X of 1986

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
SINDH EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Sindh
Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1992]
No. PAS.Legis.B-14/91, dated
22-2-1992.--The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Bill,
1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment in Sindh Act X of 1986.--In the Sindh Employees
Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986, hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
after the words "special allowance" wherever occurring except in
section 3, the words "and additional special allowance" shall be
added.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Insertion of section 3-A of Sindh Act X of 1986

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
SINDH EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Sindh
Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1992]
No. PAS.Legis.B-14/91, dated
22-2-1992.--The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Bill,
1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 14th October,
1991 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 13th February, 1992 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Insertion of section 3-A of Sindh Act X of 1986.--In the said
Act, after section 3, the following new section 3-A shall be added:--
"3-A. Every
employee, irrespective of wages being paid to him, shall in respect of his employment
on or after the 1st day of December, 1990 be paid by his employer an additional
special allowance equal to two hundred rupees per month.
